project_context.app_type: hybrid_fullstack (mobile-first personal finance dashboard app, PWA-like)
project_context.target_audience: Individuals wanting tight control and clear visibility over their personal finances.

theme_concept: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy. A grounded, trustworthy aesthetic that avoids generic 'tech blue'. Focuses on deep greens, warm stone grays, and terracotta accents for alerts. Minimalist, professional, heavily optimized for mobile.

headings.usage: Used for all H1-H4. Must use tracking-tight.

typography.technical_rules: H1 max size is text-4xl on mobile. Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + text-xs + tracking-[0.2em]. No Inter for headings.

colors.surfaces: Use pure white #FFFFFF for cards with a subtle 1px border (#E5E5E5). Do not use dark gradients. For dark mode (if toggled), use #0A0A0A base and #141414 cards.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows only for floating action buttons or active modals. Cards should rely on 1px borders instead of shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards. Nested elements should have proportionate radii.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Sticky headers and bottom nav must use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Cards are solid backgrounds.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Default layout must be optimized for mobile (w-full). Use a sticky bottom navigation bar (fixed bottom-0 z-50 w-full).
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style layout for desktop (grid-cols-4), but stacks cleanly on mobile (grid-cols-1).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6 for cards). Gap-4 for lists.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Numbers and monetary values right-aligned. Labels and text left-aligned.

components.navigation: Sticky bottom nav on mobile with 5 items: Início, Movimentações, Compromissos, Planejamento, Relatórios. On desktop, this becomes a left sidebar.
components.quick_action: Massive, highly visible Floating Action Button (FAB) '+ LANÇAR GASTO' anchored above the bottom nav.
components.cards: Cardless or subtle borders. Flat, dense styles.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Ensure color-blind friendly palettes using the defined state colors.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI Inputs, Selects, and DatePickers (calendar). Native inputs are forbidden.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog/Drawer for the 'Lançar Gasto' and 'Posso comprar?' tools to ensure rapid data entry.

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons (slight scale down or color shift).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties, e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.
motion_and_interactions.lists: Staggered entrance animations for transaction lists.

media_and_icons.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) with Duotone or Regular weights. They provide a polished, consistent look for finance apps.
media_and_icons.images: Not heavily reliant on photos. Use abstract, soft geometric SVGs for empty states if needed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Check green/red text against white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set up Tailwind variables to match the Earthy & Organic palette.
Implement the bottom navigation as a sticky element with glassmorphism.
Build the dashboard using a dense, high-clarity layout showing 'Disponível real projetado' as the hero metric.
Ensure the 'Posso comprar?' tool is a quick-access modal or dedicated screen with clear Green/Yellow/Red indicators.
Implement the 365 days challenge using a Shadcn calendar or a custom grid of 365 small blocks.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Left-align text, right-align numbers.
All modals/dialogs for data entry must be fast, auto-focusing on the amount input.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered layouts, simplistic gradients).
Create depth with layered elements and z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and headers.
NO generic AI emojis for icons.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) where applicable, even on mobile to avoid cramped UI.
